output:
Executive conclusion
- The team is making progress on core RAG components and system design, with a focus on modularity and deployment. However, there are ongoing challenges with defining and implementing advanced agent capabilities and a structured knowledge base, requiring continued guidance and refinement.

Completed
- Dakshinya Nachimuthu · Qdrant Cloud Cluster Setup: Dakshinya successfully created a free Qdrant cloud cluster and obtained the API key and endpoint for connection. Quote: "Create free cluster, click it. Refresh. Tap on a type it quickly. Ah, create big, create big, uh. Yeah. Hyphen, ohh, OK, OK. I think, wait, wait, just do under score omnics under score meeting, it will work. Ah, create a big question. Done." [17 August 2026, 15-16 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Dakshinya Nachimuthu · Initial System Design for RAG: Dakshinya presented a three-system architecture for the RAG pipeline, including parsing/chunking/embedding/vector store (System 1), retrieval service with strategies/prompt builder/context engineering/reranker (System 2), and a unified evaluation system (System 3). Quote: "Parsing, cleaning, semantic chunking, embedding generation, vector store, that is system one. OK, system two is the main rack slash retrieval service, subsystem, strategy one, expanded, strategy two, strategy four, then you have the prompt builder, context engineering engine, reusable rerun." [17 August 2026, 42 — Siddharth Saminathan]

In Progress
- Himaya Perumal · Agent Capabilities Refinement: Himaya is working on refining the capabilities of the team intelligence agent, focusing on understanding the definition of "intelligence" in this context and how it differs from simple RAG. Next step is to remake the capabilities based on feedback. [17 August 2026, 3-4 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Himaya Perumal · Mentor and Manager Agent Development: Himaya is tasked with building working mentor and manager agents, ensuring they leverage existing RAG capabilities and focus on harness, context, and prompt engineering. Next step is to demonstrate working agents with logs. [17 August 2026, 13-14 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Dakshinya Nachimuthu · RAG System Modularization and API Wrapper: Dakshinya is transforming the existing Python file into modular subsystems (System 1, 2, 3) with a Fast API architecture for reusability. Next step is to implement version one of the code base changes and push to GitHub. [17 August 2026, 42-43 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Dakshinya Nachimuthu · Qdrant Cloud Integration for System 1: Dakshinya needs to connect her first system (data ingestion to vector store) to the Qdrant cloud cluster. Next step is to complete the modularization of System 1 and create a small API layer for it. [18 August 2026, 2 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Ganesh Krishna · Knowledge Base Schema Definition: Ganesh is defining a JSON schema for the knowledge base, focusing on capturing assignments, QA events, and concept coverage. Next step is to complete a V1 version of the profile schema and demonstrate it. [18 August 2026, 7-8 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Ganesh Krishna · Normalization Pipeline Development: Ganesh is building a pipeline to read transcripts, normalize them, and output JSONL, with a focus on making it robust with proper error logging. Next step is to push the normalized data as a new collection to Dakshinya's Qdrant cloud. [18 August 2026, 4-5 — Siddharth Saminathan]

Blocked or At Risk
- Himaya Perumal · Team Intelligence Agent Vagueness: The capabilities for the team intelligence agent are currently vague, indicating a lack of clear understanding of what "intelligence" means in this context. Resolution State: Agreed. Siddharth provided a detailed explanation and examples of expected intelligent behavior. [17 August 2026, 3-4 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Himaya Perumal · Duplicate Documents in Qdrant Collection: Himaya needs to remove duplicate documents from her Qdrant collection and create a new collection with updated documents. Resolution State: Agreed. [18 August 2026, 4-5 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Ganesh Krishna · Knowledge Base Dependency: Himaya's agent skills are heavily dependent on Ganesh completing the knowledge base. Resolution State: Agreed. Himaya is advised to come up with her own skills using Dakshinya's P4 in the interim. [18 August 2026, 8-9 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Dakshinya Nachimuthu · Reranker Functionality: The reranker for Dakshinya's RAG experiments is working, but its exact functionality and confirmation of its operation are unclear. Resolution State: Pending Decision. Dakshinya needs to clarify and confirm the reranker's behavior. [17 August 2026, 45 — Siddharth Saminathan]

Important Changes
- Qdrant Cloud Adoption: The team is transitioning from local vector stores to Qdrant cloud for storing embeddings, with Dakshinya leading the initial setup and deployment. This will enable shared access and a more robust infrastructure. [17 August 2026, 13-19 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Shift to Service-Oriented Architecture: The RAG system is being refactored into three distinct services (vector store, retrieval, evaluation) wrapped in a Fast API, moving away from a single Python file. This promotes modularity and reusability. [17 August 2026, 10-11 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Knowledge Base Introduction: A structured knowledge base (likely Postgres-based) is being introduced to store structured information like assignments, QA events, and concept coverage, complementing the RAG system which primarily handles facts from transcripts. [18 August 2026, 5-6 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- GitHub Shared Repository for Documents: A shared GitHub repository will be created to store training documents, replacing the current manual transfer methods. [17 August 2026, 12-13 — Siddharth Saminathan]

Requires Attention
- Knowledge Base Design Consolidation: Ganesh needs to finalize the knowledge base schema and design, and a consolidation meeting is required to integrate his ideas with Siddharth's brainstorming. Recommended executive intervention: Schedule a dedicated session for Ganesh and Siddharth to finalize the knowledge base schema and design. [18 August 2026, 7-8 — Siddharth Saminathan]
- Agent Skill Definition and Uniqueness: Himaya needs to clearly define the role, purpose, and unique value proposition of each agent (Manager, Mentor, Team Intelligence) to avoid redundancy and ensure meaningful contributions. Recommended executive intervention: Provide Himaya with specific examples or a framework for defining agent uniqueness and value. [28 July 2026, 119 — Himaya Perumal]
- Prompt Engineering and Modularity: Dakshinya's prompts are currently hard-coded, hindering flexibility and maintainability. Recommended executive intervention: Emphasize the importance of a prompt builder service and modular prompt design to Dakshinya. [17 August 2026, 10-11 — Siddharth Saminathan]
